notes: List prices, opened on the official pages on the as_of date. Every rate is per unit in USD unless marked. Change a number here; the code reads this file.

telephony.note: Rates above = call leg + Media Streams. The number's monthly fee is a fixed cost, not per call. Recording uses our own WAV, not Twilio recording ($0.0025/min).

stt.provider: Deepgram Nova-3 streaming (English), pay as you go
stt.note: We use NVIDIA nemotron-asr-streaming, which is a free trial service with no per-minute price (production needs an NVIDIA AI Enterprise licence, $4,500 per GPU per year, plus the GPU). Deepgram is the list price of an equivalent paid streaming STT. Its page marks this as a promo price (earlier $0.0077).

llm.note: Cached input tokens get 50% off. groq.com/pricing renders with JavaScript, so the rates were read from Groq's model docs.

tts.note: No per-character fee; its CPU time is in the server line. Hosted references: Cartesia Sonic $38-65 per 1M characters (https://cartesia.ai/pricing), ElevenLabs Flash $0.04 per 1K (https://elevenlabs.io/pricing/api).

server.instance: AWS EC2 c7i.large (2 vCPU, 4 GiB), Mumbai ap-south-1, Linux on-demand
server.note: concurrent_calls is an assumption, not measured: Kokoro synthesis is CPU-bound, so 2 calls per 2-vCPU VM is the conservative starting point.
